title: One line of an experiment's append-only release ledger, releases.jsonl (F19 plan v5 §2.3; ADR-0018 D6)
description: Every step of the release protocol appends one event, flushed and synced like an attempt line. Each line names the SHA-256 of the line before it (the first names the genesis hash of this schema id), so an edited or removed line breaks the chain; a run record names the chain's hash after its collection.
